description:
Discover Your Future with Inmar Intelligence: Where Potential Meets Purpose
 For more than 45 years, Inmar Intelligence has helped some of the world’s leading brands, retailers, and healthcare organizations solve complex challenges through data, technology, and innovation. Our work has a meaningful impact on everyday life — from helping consumers save money to making healthcare safer and more efficient and helping businesses operate smarter. 
 
 Behind that work are people who are curious, collaborative, and motivated to make things better. At Inmar, our High Challenge, High Support culture creates an environment where people are encouraged to stretch their thinking, take on meaningful challenges, and grow — with the support and partnership to succeed. 
 
 Where Potential Meets Purpose comes to life through the opportunities our interns have to learn, contribute, and grow. You bring your curiosity, perspective, and what you’ve learned so far. We give you opportunities to put that potential to work on real business challenges, contribute to projects that matter, and learn alongside experienced professionals invested in your growth. 
 
 At Inmar, we believe in: 
 Raising the Bar in everything we do 

 Seeking Truth Together through collaboration and learning 

 Putting our Customer First

 
 Your internship is a chance to explore what you’re capable of, build skills through real experience, and begin shaping what comes next. 
 
 About This Opportunity
 Inmar’s Summer Internship Program offers a dynamic experience designed to give students real-world exposure to a professional environment while contributing meaningfully to company initiatives. Interns split their time between a high-impact cross-functional team project and department-specific responsibilities assigned by their direct manager. 
 
 Our Software Engineering Internship opportunities give aspiring technologists the chance to apply what they’ve learned to real products, platforms, and business challenges. Depending on business needs, opportunities may be available across engineering teams supporting Healthcare, Pharmacy, Marketing Technology, Media and Incentives, financial services, internal platforms, and other technology solutions . 
 
 As a Software Engineering intern, you may contribute to modern SaaS applications, APIs, cloud services, user interfaces, internal tools, infrastructure modernization, software quality and test automation, performance and reliability initiatives , or emerging technology projects. You’ll gain exposure to the software development lifecycle while working alongside experienced engineers and collaborating with partners across Product, Design, Data, Quality, and other technology teams. 
 
 Specific technologies and assignments will vary by team, giving interns the opportunity to apply their current skills while learning new languages, frameworks, platforms, and engineering practices. 
 
 Please note: These internship opportunities are expected to be based onsite at our Winston-Salem, NC location and will require in-person attendance during the summer. This posting is intended to build our candidate pipeline for anticipated Summer 2027 Software Engineering internship opportunities. Specific internship assignments, responsibilities, team placement, and technology stack will be based on business needs and determined as opportunities are finalized.  
 
 What You May Do
 Depending on your internship assignment, you may: 
 Contribute to the design, development, testing, and delivery of software solutions used in real business environments. 

 Build or enhance front-end applications, backend services, APIs, cloud-based solutions, or internal tools . 

 Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code while learning and applying engineering best practices. 

 Develop or enhance automated tests and testing frameworks that help ensure software quality, accuracy, and reliability. 

 Support performance testing, benchmarking, or other initiatives that help teams understand and improve application scalability and system performance. 

 Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, code reviews, technical discussions, and team collaboration . 

 Troubleshoot, debug, test, and improve existing applications for quality, performance, reliability, and scalability . 

 Support the development and modernization of secure, scalable cloud infrastructure and services . 

 Work with data, integrations, authentication, authorization, or other components that support modern software platforms. 

 Research technical challenges and help evaluate or propose potential solutions. 

 Explore opportunities to apply AI, automation, data, and emerging technologies to products, testing, engineering workflows, or business challenges. 

 Collaborate with engineers and cross-functional partners to understand requirements and translate them into working technology. 

 Contribute to products and platforms that support industries such as healthcare, pharmacy, retail, digital media, and marketing technology . 

 
 What You’ll Gain
 Hands-on experience contributing to real software products and engineering initiatives . 

 Exposure to the full software development lifecycle, from planning and design through development, testing, and delivery. 

 Experience working with modern programming languages, frameworks, cloud technologies, development tools, and engineering practices. 

 Opportunities to strengthen your skills in software design, test automation, debugging, performance, problem-solving, code quality, and technical communication . 

 Experience working in an Agile, collaborative engineering environment. 

 Exposure to how Software Engineering partners with Product, Design, Data, Quality, and other functions to build reliable, scalable solutions . 

 Mentorship and guidance from experienced engineers and technology professionals. 

 A better understanding of potential career paths across Software Engineering, Full-Stack Development, Backend Engineering, Cloud and Platform Engineering, Quality Engineering, Test Automation, Performance Engineering, and related technology fields . 

 
 Your Qualifications
 Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Health Informatics, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 

 Understanding of core computer science and software engineering concepts such as data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, and software design . 

 Experience with at least one programming language such as Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, C#, or another modern language . 

 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a willingness to work through unfamiliar technical challenges. 

 Familiarity with version control concepts and tools such as Git . 

 Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with others. 

 Curiosity about technology and a willingness to learn new languages, frameworks, tools, and development practices. 

 Ability to adapt, ask questions, take feedback, and contribute in a fast-paced, team-oriented engineering environment. 

 
 Depending on the Assignment, Preferred Skills May Include
 Coursework or project experience in software development, web development, cloud computing, databases, APIs, distributed systems, or software testing . 

 Experience with languages or frameworks such as C#/.NET, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, Vue, Java, or Python . 

 Familiarity with SQL, relational databases, BigQuery, or other data technologies . 

 Exposure to cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform or Microsoft Azure . 

 Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes . 

 Exposure to authentication, authorization, application security, or identity platforms. 

 Experience building or consuming REST APIs or cloud-based services . 

 Familiarity with automated testing frameworks or tools such as Playwright, MS Test, Selenium, or similar technologies . 

 Exposure to performance testing, load testing, benchmarking, or application monitoring . 

 Familiarity with Agile software development practices. 

 Interest or experience with AI, automation, machine learning, or emerging development tools . 

 Personal, academic, or open-source software projects that demonstrate curiosity and hands-on experience in development, testing, automation, or technical problem-solving . 

 
 Why Intern at Inmar Intelligence
 Your summer at Inmar is about putting what you’ve learned into practice while continuing to discover where your interests and strengths can take you. You’ll contribute to real-world projects , work alongside experienced professionals, and see how data, technology, automation, and innovation are shaping the future of business. 
 
 Beyond your day-to-day work, you’ll build connections through mentorship, cross-functional networking, and collaboration with fellow interns , with learning and development opportunities designed to support your growth. You’ll gain experience you can carry forward while exploring potential career paths and building relationships across Inmar. 
 
 You’ll also be part of an environment where different perspectives are valued, ideas are encouraged, and community impact matters — giving you the opportunity to grow professionally while contributing to something bigger than your individual assignment. 
 
 Bring your potential. Find your purpose. Discover your future at Inmar.
 
 
 
 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability/vets. 
 
 Recruitment Fraud Notice:   Recruitment fraud is an increasingly common scam where individuals pose as employers to offer fictitious job opportunities. Scammers sometimes impersonate Inmar recruiters on LinkedIn and other channels. We will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. Verify any role on our official Workday Careers site and learn how to spot scams in our   full notice . 
 
 This position is not eligible for student visa sponsorship, including F-1 OPT or CPT. Candidates must have authorization to work in the U.S. without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.
